The Office Manager ensures the smooth daily operation of the shopping centre through administrative management, coordination with internal teams and tenants, and professional reception of visitors. They support management with reporting, agenda management and information handling, while maintaining accurate records and ensuring efficient communication across the site.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day‑to‑day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

 

Omschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow‑up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision‑making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

 

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands‑on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping‑centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time‑management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: IT Manager - New Plant Setup, Infrastructure & ERP
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a global leader in advanced technology solutions. The company expands its manufacturing footprint with new factory investments and advanced production facilities in Thailand. It also operates with international standards and serves customers worldwide through its global engineering and manufacturing network.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and manage all IT operations, ensuring stable and secure technology services across the organization.
• Plan, coordinate, and execute IT infrastructure setup for new factories, buildings, and office expansions.
• Manage network, servers, cloud services, cybersecurity, backup, and disaster recovery solutions.

• Develop and implement IT policies, standards, and best practices.
• Monitor IT security risks and ensure compliance with company and regulatory requirements.
• Prepare and manage the annual IT budget and technology investment plans.
• Provide technical guidance and leadership to the IT team and end users.
• Collaborate with local and global stakeholders to support business objectives and digital transformation initiatives.
• Prepare reports and present IT updates, project progress, and recommendations to management.
• Ensure effective communication with regional and global teams in English.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• 7+ years of IT experience with at least 3 years in an IT Manager or leadership role.
• Strong experience in both IT Infrastructure and ERP/Application management.
• Experience supporting manufacturing or industrial environments.
• Proven experience managing factory startup, plant expansion, or new building IT projects.
• Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, Epicor, or similar.
• Good understanding of network infrastructure, servers, virtualization, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, and backup solutions.
• Strong project management and vendor management skills.
• Excellent problem-solving and stakeholder management abilities.
• Able to communicate effectively in English with international teams and management.

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of ISO, IATF, or regulated manufacturing environments.
• PMP, ITIL, Microsoft, Cisco, or cybersecurity certifications are an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Freelance Project Manager Warehouse - Brownfield Project
jobs.description:
Our client is a rapidly expanding international consumer goods company strengthening its footprint across Central & Eastern Europe. To support this growth, they are launching a new warehouse and transport platform in the Czech Republic that will serve the entire CEE region.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Project Manager Warehouse your responsibilities are:

• Participate in the final tender and negotiation phase to select and contract the warehouse partner in the Czech Republic.
• Define and implement warehouse operating procedures (SOPs) together with the selected 3PL.
• Prepare the dedicated warehouse areas and align operational ways of working with the logistics partner.
• Establish KPI tracking, governance routines, and daily/weekly/monthly performance reviews.
• Set up the transport network for parcel and pallet flows across all Central & Eastern European countries.
• Negotiate with transport providers and manage commercial and operational discussions.
• Work closely with the IT team on the integration between the company ERP (Infor M3) and the 3PL WMS platform.
• Monitor warehouse and transport performance, customer service levels, stock accuracy, inbound/outbound activities, and delivery lead times.
• Analyze operational data and provide KPI reporting to management.
• Support business growth by identifying service and logistics optimization opportunities.
• Prepare the operational handover to the future Logistics Manager after the stabilization phase.

A successful Freelance Project Manager Warehouse should have:

• Proven experience managing warehouse setup, 3PL implementation, or logistics transformation projects in an international environment.
• Strong background in warehousing and transport operations.
• Experience running RFP/RFQ processes and negotiating with logistics providers.
• Knowledge of consumer goods, retail fashion, B2B distribution, or e-commerce logistics is a strong advantage.
• Fluent Czech and English are mandatory.
